source: Actual Home screens rendered by the ReVo firmware in fm1-emu; no newly drawn animation.
bioma: 24 native Home captures, 220 ms apart. Native birds, insect pulses and water ripples.
atolls: 35 native Home captures for each selected loop, at about 400 ms per pair. Composite original red A and cyan B Home pixels over the unchanged native island. No paths or sprites added.
creatures: Original creature() renderer from ilha_ui.c; native Birds, Insects and Water at scale3.
